"### Chart Description: EMBIG Sovereign Spreads

The chart displays sovereign spreads in basis points (bps) for "Emerging markets" and "Argentina" across two separate time-series panels.

**General Information:**
*   **Title:** EMBIG Sovereign Spreads
*   **Unit:** Basis points (bps)
*   **Series 1 (Dark Blue Line):** Emerging markets
*   **Series 2 (Light Blue Line):** Argentina

---

### Panel 1: Historical Trend (Dec-23 to May-24)
This panel uses the **left-hand Y-axis**, ranging from **200 to 500 bps**.

| Date | Emerging Markets (Approx. bps) | Argentina (Approx. bps) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dec-23** | Starts ~350 | Starts ~325 |
| **Jan-24** | Peaks ~375, ends ~350 | Fluctuates between 310–350 |
| **Feb-24** | Steady decline to ~320 | Decline to ~280 |
| **Mar-24** | Steady decline to ~280 | Hits low of ~225, ends ~250 |
| **Apr-24** | Sharp jump from ~285 to ~335 | Low of ~220, ends ~230 |
| **May-24** | Fluctuates between 325–340 | Rises to ~260, ends ~240 |

---

### Panel 2: Recent Developments (June 1 to June 7)
This panel provides a zoomed-in view of early June, utilizing the **right-hand Y-axis (rhs)**, ranging from **1000 to 3000 bps**. 

*Note: While the legend indicates "(rhs)" for Argentina, both series in this specific panel appear to be plotted against the larger 1000–3000 scale.*

| Date | Emerging Markets (Approx. bps) | Argentina (Approx. bps) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1-Jun** | ~1900 | ~1400 |
| **3-Jun** | ~2200 | ~1400 |
| **5-Jun** | ~2350 | ~1650 |
| **7-Jun** | ~2400 | ~1750 |
